# Feature Specification: Email Login

**Feature Branch**: `002-login`
**Input**: User description: "Users sign in with email and a one-time code."

## User Scenarios & Testing *(mandatory)*

### User Story 1 - Sign in with a code (Priority: P1)

A user enters their email, receives a code and signs in.

## Requirements *(mandatory)*

### Functional Requirements

- **FR-001**: System MUST send a 6-digit code by email.
- **FR-002**: Codes MUST expire after [NEEDS CLARIFICATION: expiry time not specified].
